title: Amazingly Sweet Egyptian Ciabatta Toast
description: A sweet and comforting Egyptian dish featuring ciabatta, with a molten and savory twist from bonito flakes, made low-sodium-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the ciabatta bread into 1-inch thick slices and place on a baking sheet.
Butter each slice of ciabatta bread with unsalted butter.
Sprinkle shaved bonito flakes over the buttered ciabatta slices.
Drizzle honey over the bonito flakes.
Sprinkle a pinch of low-sodium salt and black pepper over the honey.
If using rose water, drizzle it over the ciabatta slices for added flavor.
Bake the ciabatta slices in the preheated oven for 5 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a minute before serving.
